text: a fixture with `pkg:` gets no target warning and a fixture with only `package:` gets one naming `pkg` (red if the script still looks for `package`)
why: The Test field names infra-build/scripts/validate-readiness.sh directly, and prove-claim refuses any break that edits a file the test command runs, so no break of the fixed line is accepted. RED was watched by hand instead: the new suite against the pre-fix script printed 'FAIL: pkg: fixture got a mac-makefile-target warning' and 'package:-only fixture did not get a warning naming pkg:' (exit 1); the nested-crate case printed 'a crate outside the repo root got a mac-no-cargo warning' (exit 1) before the cargo check was removed. Both green after the fix.
